publication.summary: HTTPS push to the fork remote was rejected by GitHub because the authorized token does not include the workflow scope required for this repository push path.
remediation: authorize a token with repo, workflow scope
or complete gh auth refresh -h github.com -s workflow in a logged-in browser
create or update a reviewable PR from the fork branch

notes: node --test tests/*.test.mjs found no tests in this checkout
node scripts/framework-doctor.mjs is not present in this checkout
npm test is not defined in the root package.json
direct pytest needs addopts suppression in this environment because the repo config injects timeout flags unavailable to the raw invocation

nextStep: Obtain a token with workflow scope, retry the fork push, and then post the reviewable branch/commit back to issue #71.
